data.name: Demonstrator
data.description: One unit flown to prove the imaging chain; flies without propulsion.

data.name: Production
data.description: Constellation unit with propulsion for orbit keeping and disposal.

data.name: Petrel spacecraft
data.description: 150 kg-class Earth-observation smallsat in a 500 km sun-synchronous orbit.

data.name: Launch vehicle
data.description: External: the rideshare launch vehicle, owned by the launch provider.

data.name: Ground station network
data.description: External: the X-band and S-band ground stations.

data.statement: Solar cells deliver 29.5% efficiency at beginning of life.
data.rationale: Datasheet value confirmed by the lot acceptance test.

data.statement: Launch random vibration stays within the provider's published envelope for 150 kg passengers.
data.rationale: The provider has not yet released the coupled-loads results for this mission.

data.statement: The imager optics weigh 24.5 kg.
data.rationale: Preliminary vendor quote; the optical design is not closed.

data.statement: The operational orbit is 500 km sun-synchronous with a 10:30 local time of descending node.

data.title: Space systems: space debris mitigation requirements
Image at 1.5 m ground sample distance
data.statement: Petrel shall deliver panchromatic imagery at a ground sample distance of 1.5 m or finer from its operational orbit.
data.rationale: The customer's change-detection product needs 1.5 m to resolve vehicles.

data.title: Five-year operational life
data.statement: A production Petrel shall operate for at least five years in orbit.

data.title: Deliver imagery within three hours
data.statement: Petrel shall deliver each image to the customer within three hours of capture.

data.title: Twelve-month demonstrator life
data.statement: The demonstrator shall operate for at least twelve months in orbit.

data.title: Launch mass at most 150 kg
data.statement: The spacecraft shall have a launch mass of 150 kg or less, including propellant.
data.rationale: Rideshare slot allowance; reduced from 155 kg when the slot changed.

data.title: First lateral frequency at least 40 Hz
data.statement: The spacecraft's first lateral natural frequency, hard-mounted at the separation plane, shall be 40 Hz or higher.

data.title: Clamp-band separation interface
data.statement: The spacecraft shall attach to the launch vehicle through a 15-inch clamp-band separation system with two breakwire connectors.

data.title: Re-enter within five years of end of mission
data.statement: A production Petrel shall re-enter the atmosphere within five years after the end of its mission.

data.title: Passivate stored energy at end of mission
data.statement: At the end of its mission the spacecraft shall discharge its battery and vent its propellant.

data.title: Protoflight verification approach
data.statement: The flight model shall be tested at qualification levels for acceptance durations; no separate qualification model is built.
data.rationale: One flight unit per variant; a qualification model would add five months.

data.title: Imaging-mode power at most 160 W
data.statement: The spacecraft's total power draw in imaging mode shall not exceed 160 W.

data.title: Pointing error at most 0.05 deg
data.statement: During imaging the payload boresight pointing error shall not exceed 0.05 deg (3 sigma).

data.title: Processor board at most 70 degC
data.statement: The on-board computer's processor board shall stay at or below 70 degC in the worst hot operating case.
data.rationale: The board's derating rules for a five-year life.

data.title: Payload mass at most 28 kg
data.statement: The imaging payload, optics and electronics together, shall weigh 28 kg or less.

data.title: Structure mass at most 40 kg
data.statement: The structure, primary structure and harness together, shall weigh 40 kg or less.

data.title: Array generation at least 180 W
data.statement: The solar array shall generate at least 180 W at end of life in the worst-case sun angle.

data.title: Battery depth of discharge at most 30%
data.statement: The battery's depth of discharge shall not exceed 30% in any orbit.
data.rationale: Keeps cycle wear inside the five-year life.

data.title: Battery between 0 and 35 degC
data.statement: The battery cells shall stay between 0 degC and 35 degC in every operating and non-operating mode.
data.rationale: Charging outside this range risks lithium plating and thermal runaway.

data.title: X-band rate at least 400 Mbit/s
data.statement: The X-band downlink shall deliver at least 400 Mbit/s of information to the ground station at 5 deg elevation.

data.title: Payload commanding over CAN at 1 Mbit/s
data.statement: The on-board computer shall command the payload over a CAN 2.0B bus at 1 Mbit/s.

data.title: Main bus at 28 V plus or minus 4 V
data.statement: The power conditioning unit shall hold the main bus between 24 V and 32 V at every load.

data.title: Low jitter during imaging
data.statement: The ADCS should keep jitter low during imaging so that images are sharp.

data.title: Delta-v at least 60 m/s
data.statement: A production Petrel shall carry propellant for at least 60 m/s of delta-v for orbit keeping and disposal.

data.name: Power to on-board computer
data.definition: 28 V plus or minus 4 V regulated supply, 3 A maximum, with current telemetry over I2C.

data.name: On-board computer to payload
data.definition: CAN 2.0B at 1 Mbit/s for commanding; LVDS at 800 Mbit/s for image data.

data.name: Payload mounting
data.definition: Three titanium bipods to the payload deck; mounted stiffness above 120 Hz.

data.name: Launch vehicle separation
data.definition: 15-inch clamp band with separation springs and two breakwire connectors.

data.name: X-band downlink
data.definition: 8.025 to 8.4 GHz, DVB-S2 with adaptive coding; 400 Mbit/s minimum at 5 deg elevation.

data.name: Battery thermal path
data.definition: Battery box conductively coupled to the radiator panel; two heater circuits on the box.

data.name: Processor board peak temperature, hot case
Battery depth of discharge per orbit
V0 breadboard
data.learning_goal: Prove that the power chain and the avionics work together on the bench.
data.exit_criteria: Battery sizing analysed and disposal analysis closed on breadboard hardware.

data.name: V1 engineering model
data.learning_goal: Find out whether the structure, thermal design and avionics survive launch and orbit environments.
data.exit_criteria: Vibration, thermal vacuum, mass properties, EMC and the X-band link pass on the engineering model.

data.name: V2 flight model
data.learning_goal: Qualify the flight model at protoflight levels.
data.exit_criteria: Every system requirement verified on the flight model.

data.title: Thermal vacuum cycling of the avionics stack
data.environment: Thermal vacuum chamber, eight cycles between -20 degC and +60 degC

data.notes: Breadboard in a thermal chamber at ambient pressure.
Hot spot at the FPGA; the conduction path from the board to the radiator is too long.

data.title: Sine and random vibration of the engineering model
data.environment: Shaker table, three axes, qualification levels

data.title: X-band end-to-end link test
data.environment: RF test set with a ground-station emulator

data.notes: The ground-station emulator lost lock; rerun scheduled.
Measured against the 155 kg allowance in force at the time.

data.title: CAN bus loopback between computer and payload
Main bus regulation across load steps
Conducted emissions on the main bus
Processor board overheats in the hot case
data.failure_mode: The FPGA hot spot exceeds the board's derated limit during long imaging passes.
data.effect: Processor resets interrupt imaging; accelerated ageing shortens life.

data.title: Optics mass grows
data.failure_mode: The vendor's mass grows as the optical design closes.
data.effect: The payload and launch mass budgets no longer close.

data.title: Battery thermal runaway
data.failure_mode: A cell overheats while charging in the hot case.
data.effect: Loss of the spacecraft and a debris event.

data.title: Frequency coordination is late
data.failure_mode: The X-band filing is not granted before launch.
data.effect: No imagery downlink at the start of operations.

data.title: Reaction wheel bearing wear
data.failure_mode: Lubricant loss wears the bearings before five years.

data.title: Separation shock damages the star tracker
data.failure_mode: The clamp-band release shock exceeds the star tracker's rating.

data.question: Accept the launch provider's reduced 150 kg allowance?
data.choice: Accept the 150 kg allowance and carry the margin at system level.
data.rationale: The rideshare slot changed; keeping 155 kg would move the launch by nine months.

data.question: Which battery cells?
data.rationale: Flight heritage and stock available within the schedule.

data.question: How to close the processor board's thermal margin?
data.choice: Add a copper heat spreader from the FPGA to the radiator panel (+0.3 kg).
data.rationale: The thermal vacuum run measured 73.4 degC against 70 degC; analysis predicts 66 degC with the spreader.

data.message: Payload mass adds up to 30.8 kg against its 28 kg allocation.
The thermal vacuum run of 2026-09-18 measured 73.4 degC against the 70 degC limit.
Not checkable: no quantity, limit or unit, and 'low' and 'sharp' are undefined.
The mass properties pass of 2026-08-20 predates the 150 kg limit set on 2026-09-29.
Imaging-mode power margin is 3 W, under 2%.

data.clause: Disposal of launch vehicle orbital stages
data.justification: Applies to the launch provider's upper stage, not the spacecraft.
